notes.title: Bug Fix Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
Fixed an issue that caused too many asteroids to spawn, inevitably slowing the game down until it crashed (it turns out that they can also kill computers, not just dinosaurs)
Dramatically reduced the attack speed perk from 50% down to 1%
Instituted a floor to the attack speed modifier so that it may not go lower than 20% of the default value

notes.title: Bug Fix Patch 0.4.4
notes.content:
Removed a bug that would allow players to join mid-game
Fixed a bug that caused the player to spawn with the incorrect amount of hull and shield
Fixed a bug that caused the selected ship speed to not influence the player's ship
Removed the speed modifier perk and increased each ships default speed modifiers
Decreased the health of enemy ship 1 from 100 to 30
Changed the way that large asteroids spawn forcing a min/max of 12 to be present in game at all times
Fixed a bug where certain enemies would jitter around causing the player to also jitter
Fixed a bug that would not allow the player to progress to the next chapter of the story mode
Added several new enemy types
Endless mode now spawns enemies at random intervals
Asteroids no longer spawn from chapter 4 onward in the story mode
